name: scrummy
description: Chief of staff for a Scrummy (Plane) work board, for Work mode, the Codex CLI and the IDE extension. Turns conversations and code into board state, says what to do next, briefs stakeholders, and flags the deadlines that cannot absorb a late start. Use this one in Work mode; use Scrummy for Chat in Chat.

interface.shortDescription: Chief of staff for your work board, in Work mode and Codex
interface.longDescription: The Codex build of Scrummy, for ChatGPT desktop in Work mode, the Codex CLI and the IDE extension. Reads and writes your work board the way an operator would: turns a brain dump or a coding session into board state, recommends what to work on next with its context loaded, briefs a team or a client at the right altitude, and works backwards from a deadline to the last day work can safely start. Signing in is OAuth, and you choose which workspaces it may reach. Working in Chat instead? Install Scrummy for Chat.
defaultPrompt: What is actually at risk on my board this week?
Capture this conversation onto the board.
